name: Puls8
description: Above the street, the water stays warm and the lights stay low. Puls8 is a rooftop lounge and pool for late hours: dark colors, neon accents, and a pool that looks better after midnight. High enough to feel private. Rough enough that you do not have to behave.

events.title: PULS8 PRESENTS: UNEMPLOYED & UNHINGED
events.blurb:
No job. No plans. No bedtime.

Your sleep schedule is a crime scene. Your screen time is classified information. Your fridge is empty, but somehow you're still awake at 4 AM.

And honestly? We respect the commitment.

So cancel your imaginary plans, ignore your responsibilities, and come rot with us in style.

Puls8: Where doing absolutely nothing is a full-time job.

sync.note: We don't run a PlayerSync syncshell. Turn on ZoneSync instead and you'll sync with everyone in the club automatically.

packs.blurb: The animated skyline that surrounds the club, worn by the venue mannequin.
